Fields.Name: Property Bag
Fields.Description: Havok's attached properties (not used by the games).

Fields.Name: Variable Bindings
Fields.Description: The bindings that drive this object's fields from behavior variables or character properties each frame.

Fields.Name: User Data
Fields.Description: A value for the game's own use; Havok doesn't read it.

Fields.Name: Name
Fields.Description: The node's name. Used to find it in the outline and in the action scripts; it doesn't have to be unique.

Fields.Name: Docking Bone
Fields.Description: The bone that's docked to the target. -1 for the character's root.

Fields.Name: Translation Offset
Fields.Description: An offset from the target's position.

Fields.Name: Rotation Offset
Fields.Description: An offset from the target's rotation.

Fields.Name: Blend Type
Fields.Description: How the docking applies: blended in over the interval, or fully at once.

Fields.Name: Docking Flags
Fields.Description: Docking options: dock to the target's future position, override the animation's motion.

Fields.Name: Child
Fields.Description: The generator that plays while docking.

Fields.Name: Interval Start
Fields.Description: When the docking starts (a sync point of the child). -1 for its start.

Fields.Name: Interval End
Fields.Description: When the docking ends (a sync point of the child). -1 for its end.

Fields.Name: Docking Type
Fields.Description: The kind of docking the game sets up (an ID the game reads).
